beats.title: Guests at the Stone House
beats.boundaryReason: Arrival, Delwath’s rescue account, and introductions form one continuous exchange; Avaras’s return with the armor changes the focus.
dateEvidence: Session YAML anchors May 2; u0015–u0017 explicitly begin current play in late afternoon.
u0002–u0014 recap earlier events and do not advance the current day.

beats.title: The Shadowed Breastplate
beats.boundaryReason: Avaras brings out the breastplate; inspection, recognition, and Delwath putting it on conclude before the monks answer wider questions.
dateEvidence: Continuous conversation after arrival; no rest or day change.

beats.title: The Monks’ Failed Cleansing
beats.boundaryReason: The monks explain their failed cleansing, Kharsan’s new menace, and the ruined monastery; they then leave to prepare dinner.
dateEvidence: Continuous afternoon conversation; u0906 subsequently announces dinnertime.

beats.title: Choosing the Road East
beats.boundaryReason: The hosts leave the room, enabling a private discussion of Delwath’s vision and the party’s route; dinner and sleep close the day.
dateEvidence: u0906 announces dinnertime; u1197–u1202 describe dinner and early bedtime.
u1211 explicitly sends everyone to sleep. The break at u1109–u1120 is real table time, not another in-world day.

beats.title: Lessons in Ki and Runes
beats.boundaryReason: A new morning and a distinct training scene justify a short beat; the next beat begins with departure from the house.
dateEvidence: u1212 explicitly begins the morning after sleep, advancing May 2 to May 3.
u1290 places Seeker’s emerging hand at lunch; u1294–u1295 finish training and wait out the heat.

beats.title: Three Days Across the Desert
beats.boundaryReason: A compact travel montage spans departure, two overnight advances, animal training, and canyon navigation; the sound of battle starts the next situation.
dateEvidence: u1296 leaves late afternoon; u1303 explicitly says three days counting today, or two more days.
u1309–u1315 narrate the first afternoon and camp; u1338 begins the next day, May 4.
u1346, u1354, u1366, and u1374 repeatedly resume that same second travel day around interruptions. u1380 anticipates arrival the following day.
u1383 begins May 5; u1395 describes its midday heat rest before the final approach.

beats.title: Scouting Havdar’s Besieged Camp
beats.boundaryReason: The party observes the ongoing battle, scouts through Seeker’s remote vision, and climbs toward the enemy casters; initiative marks the next tactical phase.
dateEvidence: Continuous with the third travel day. u1380 predicts arrival around dinner; u1403–u1408 announce the approach and sounds of battle after the midday rest.
Evening is an inferred broad window from expected dinnertime arrival, not an exact stated battle time.

beats.title: Fire on the Canyon Rim
beats.boundaryReason: Initiative, the orcs’ charge, Fireball, and the first exchanges form the opening party-combat phase; Seeker’s next action removes the fire mage.
dateEvidence: Initiative begins at u1650; no intervening world-time transition after the approach.

beats.title: Breaking the Orc Assault
beats.boundaryReason: The fire mage and ordinary orcs fall, the leader is stunned, and Delwath blinks away; the last caster’s phantom hand begins the final phase.
dateEvidence: Consecutive rounds of the same battle; the brief table interruption at u2037–u2058 does not advance the in-world day.

beats.title: One Orc Taken Alive
beats.boundaryReason: The phantom hand, the leader’s death, capture of the final caster, and defeat of the remaining orcs below close the battle and session.
dateEvidence: Same continuous battle through u2359–u2368; interrogation is deferred to the next session, with no further in-world day transition.
